reason: 依据 README，该插件的主要用户面对功能是为 DSH 提供插件市场与插件生命周期管理（仓库配置、安装/移除、静态启停），属于面向插件管理的开发支撑工具，不是搜索、可视化或知识类插件。

summaries.zh: DSH 插件市场插件在设置页集中提供插件仓库管理与插件安装、移除及静态插件启停能力，并支持下载前校验与状态持久化。
summaries.en: The DSH Plugin Market plugin provides a settings-based workflow for managing plugin repositories and installing or removing plugins, with plugin lifecycle controls and validation/state persistence.

capabilities: manage user-configured HTTPS plugin repositories and plugin catalog refresh/install/remove actions
validate plugin metadata and checksums before accepting downloaded plugin content
persist static plugin enable/disable state and dynamic plugin lifecycle-related controls to local DSH home files

reasons.code: README 描述“用户可以在设置页添加 HTTPS 插件仓库、刷新目录、安装/移除插件”并支持静态/动态插件管理。
README 说明下载前会验证 HTTPS、manifest、entry 与 SHA-256 校验和，且下载先写临时目录再原子替换安装目录。
README 指出静态插件的启停状态写入 `$DSH_HOME/plugins/market/static.patch.yml`，下次启动生效。
功能描述中明确包含“Web 设置页”，表明该能力对用户可操作。

capabilities: manage user-configured HTTPS plugin repositories and plugin catalog refresh/install/remove actions
validate plugin metadata and checksums before accepting downloaded plugin content
persist static plugin enable/disable state and dynamic plugin lifecycle-related controls to local DSH home files
